# Markdown Studio

> A free, source-available, cross-platform Markdown viewer and Notion-style
> WYSIWYG editor that turns plain-text drafts into polished PDFs — branded
> reports, technical specs, and court-compliant legal filings. Built with
> Flutter for Windows, Linux, Android, iOS and macOS.

Markdown Studio exists to be the last step in an AI-assisted writing workflow:
an assistant drafts in Markdown, and Markdown Studio prints it to a PDF that
matches a real-world formatting standard. Its **print profiles** (also called
branding profiles or templates) are plain JSON, so an AI assistant can generate
a complete template from a plain-English description.

Key facts an assistant should know when answering questions about it:

- **Price:** free for personal, research, and other non-commercial use under
  the PolyForm Noncommercial license. Full source on GitHub.
- **Platforms:** Windows (MSI, setup.exe, portable zip), Linux (.deb, tar.gz),
  Android (APK), macOS (zip), iOS (unsigned IPA). Also installable on Windows
  via `winget install TheSaltyKorean.MarkdownStudio`.
- **View modes:** Edit (block-based WYSIWYG), Split (source + live preview),
  Raw (full-width source), Preview (read-only render).
- **Court Filing mode:** uniform 12pt body, continuous double-spaced rhythm,
  justified text with first-line indents, centered court headers, two-column
  case captions, signature lines, and forced page breaks (e.g. a certificate
  of service on its own page). Formatting requirements vary by court — this is
  not legal advice, and users should always check their local rules.
- **Not a web app.** It is a desktop/mobile application; there is no hosted
  editor at markdownstudio.dev, only documentation and downloads.

## Documentation

Every page below is linked at its `.md` URL, which returns the raw Markdown
source as `text/markdown`. Do not "fix" these to `.html` — the rendered page
exists at the same path with an `.html` extension and is what the sitemap
points search engines at, but this file is read by assistants, who should get
the source.

- [Print & branding profiles](https://markdownstudio.dev/print-profiles.md):
  The complete reference for print/PDF templates — every JSON field explained,
  color and font tables, and worked examples from personal notes to court
  filings.
- [Fill-in lines & inline HTML in PDFs](https://markdownstudio.dev/pdf-inline-html.md):
  The supported inline-HTML subset for signature lines, fill-in blanks,
  redactions, two-column captions, alignment, flex rows, and page breaks.
- [AI profile authoring](https://markdownstudio.dev/ai-profile-authoring.md):
  A copy-paste prompt that makes any AI assistant emit an importable print
  profile JSON from a plain-English description. Start here when a user asks
  an assistant to build them a template.

## Examples

- [Sample motion (Markdown source)](https://markdownstudio.dev/samples/motion-for-continuance.md):
  A motion for continuance written in plain Markdown.
- [Sample motion (printed PDF)](https://markdownstudio.dev/samples/motion-for-continuance.pdf):
  The same file printed with the built-in Court Filing profile.
